title: Cookie Policy
summary: The cookies and local storage the CampusEduX website uses, and why.
intro: This Cookie Policy explains how the {{appName}} website ({{website}}) uses cookies and similar on-device storage. It applies to the website only — the {{appName}} mobile app does not use cookies.

CampusEduX uses essential cookies for sign-in and security. Google Analytics sends limited cookieless measurements while analytics cookies are denied. Analytics cookies require your consent. When we display advertising, Google AdSense and third-party vendors may use cookies and identifiers as described below; advertising is off by default and requires separate consent.

sections.heading: 1. What cookies and local storage are
body: A cookie is a small text file a website stores in your browser. "Local storage" and "session storage" are similar browser features that let a site remember small pieces of information on your device. We describe both here because we use both.

sections.heading: 2. Strictly necessary cookies
body: These keep you signed in and keep the site secure. They cannot be switched off through the site because the signed-in parts of the website would not work without them.
bullets: Authentication and session cookies set by our authentication provider ({{infraProviderName}}) when you sign in — they hold your session token and a refresh token so you stay signed in between pages and visits, and are cleared when you sign out.
A short-lived code-verifier cookie used only during the sign-in / email-confirmation exchange.
A first-party consent preference cookie remembers your analytics and advertising choices for 12 months.

sections.heading: 3. Functional local storage
body: The website stores a few preferences in your browser's local or session storage so features behave sensibly. This data stays in your browser, is not sent to us as a tracking signal, and you can clear it any time from your browser settings.
bullets: Unsaved code you have typed in the online Compiler and Coding Problem editors, and your last-used language, so a refresh does not lose your work.
A short-lived hand-off value used when you send a code snippet from a lesson to the Compiler.
A flag remembering that you dismissed an announcement banner, so it does not reappear on every page.

sections.heading: 4. Analytics cookies
body: The website loads Google Analytics 4 (GA4) on public pages with analytics storage denied by default. While cookies are denied, GA4 sends limited cookieless measurements, including page views and technical request information. If you allow analytics, GA4 may set cookies such as `_ga` and `_ga_<container-id>` in your browser. Cookieless measurement still sends data to Google.

Our GA4 setup reports page views only: it is not linked to your CampusEduX account, and we have not enabled Google Signals or advertising personalisation in our GA4 property. Google's own privacy policy explains how Google may process data collected through GA4: https://policies.google.com/privacy.

Analytics cookies are not strictly necessary. You can reject them in the banner or change your choice later through Cookie settings in the footer. Rejecting analytics cookies keeps analytics storage denied; limited cookieless measurements continue. Browser blocking tools can also block Google Analytics requests.

sections.heading: 5. Payment provider cookies
body: When you make a payment, the checkout is opened by our payment processor, {{paymentProcessorName}}. Their checkout may set its own cookies on their domain to process the payment securely and prevent fraud. Those cookies are controlled by {{paymentProcessorName}} under their own policy: {{paymentProcessorPrivacyUrl}}. They are only involved when you actively start a payment.

sections.heading: 6. Advertising cookies (when we display advertising)
body: When we display advertising, Google and third-party vendors may use cookies and other identifiers to serve ads based on previous visits to this or other websites. Personalised ads may reflect your interests. Non-personalised ads use contextual information but may still use cookies for measurement, frequency capping and fraud prevention.

Advertising scripts are not loaded unless advertising is enabled and you have allowed the Advertising category. Reject non-essential declines analytics cookies and advertising; Manage lets you choose them separately. Limited cookieless analytics measurements continue. You can withdraw advertising consent through Cookie settings in the footer. Withdrawal stops future advertising loads; you can clear previously stored vendor cookies in your browser.

Learn how Google uses information from partner sites at https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites and about advertising technologies at https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads. Manage Google ad personalisation at https://adssettings.google.com/ and participating vendors at https://www.aboutads.info/choices/. Opting out of personalisation does not necessarily stop cookies used for non-personalised ads.

The current banner is not a Google-certified TCF consent management platform. Before serving personalised ads in the EEA, UK or Switzerland, we must integrate a Google-certified platform. These website advertising disclosures do not change the mobile app disclosures.

sections.heading: 7. Managing cookies
body: You can delete or block cookies and clear local storage in your browser settings. If you block the strictly necessary cookies described in section 2, you will not be able to sign in or use your account, but the public pages (projects, jobs, learning, legal pages) will still work.

On your first visit, the fixed cookie banner offers Accept all, Reject non-essential, and Manage. Manage lets you switch optional analytics and advertising cookies on or off; essential cookies remain on. Your choice is stored in a first-party cookie for 12 months.

Use the Cookie settings link in the footer to change your choice at any time. If you turn analytics cookies off, the website updates analytics storage to denied and clears first-party GA cookies it can access. Limited cookieless measurements continue on public pages. You can also clear cookies in your browser settings.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to this policy
body: If we add or remove a cookie or storage mechanism, we will update this page and, where the law requires it, ask for your consent first. The version and date at the top of this page show when it last changed.
